title: Sell out by nine
_note: Example 8-slide carousel for a fictional bakery: a photo cover, one number, two steps, a contrast, a quote, the recap and the call to action. Each slide picks a template (layout) and fills its fields; slide and total are filled in automatically. Image paths are relative to this file. Sources and hashtags go in the caption, never on the slides.

caption: Selling out is a plan, not a lucky morning. Here is the weekly rhythm we use at our (fictional) bakery: menu on Thursday, orders closed Friday noon, bake to the list. Save it for your next slow week.
